quiz.question: A Windows PC has an address starting with 169.254. What does that usually mean?
options: It couldn't reach a DHCP server
quiz.answer_text: It couldn't reach a DHCP server
quiz.why: 169.254 is APIPA: Windows assigns it to itself when no DHCP server answers.
